description:
What is This Part?
This is a Genuine Suzuki OEM Transmission Clutch Cable for the RHD Suzuki Samurai that runs from the Shifter Arm located on the Transmission to the Clutch Pedal.
Note: I also sell the LHD Clutch Cables
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Clutch Cable – RHD (59″)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985-1995 (Fits Right Hand Drive Models Only)
Suzuki SJ413 1985-1995 (Fits Right Hand Drive Models Only)
Suzuki SJ410 1980-1984 (Fits Right Hand Drive Models Only)
